Team —

Following up on our FY26 Q2 hiring plan: I’m requesting approval to open two headcount slots that are time-sensitive. Details below and attached: comp-band-Q2-2026.pdf and headcount-request-worksheet.xlsx.

1) Senior FP&A Analyst (IC, level 4) — core FP&A role to support ARR forecasting and monthly reforecast cadence. Requesting range midpoint: $150k base +/- 8%, budgeted OTE incl. bonus ~ $165k. Candidate pipeline is narrow; Greenlight Talent has a candidate who can start mid-April.

2) Billing Operations Manager (Manager, RevOps/Billing) — replace a contractor role and add ownership of invoicing automation, collections SLA, and billing taxonomy. Requesting range midpoint: $170k base +/- 7%, OTE with bonus ~ $182k. This role reduces contractor spend and improves DSO.

Rationale: Both roles are measurable: FP&A reduces forecast variance; Billing Ops eliminates $40k/quarter in contractor spend and improves cash collection timelines (proj. payback < 6 months). The headcount worksheet shows net budget impact and proposed funding: move $35k from partner events line and reallocate underspend in tools for Q2.

Asks: Marcus — budget approval for two FTEs (we can absorb within Q2 if approved). Laura — can HR finalize offer band and sign-off on job posting and comp band? Marissa — hiring manager alignment and test case for the interview loop. Priyom — please confirm the job scoring template for the Billing Ops role.

Attachments: comp-band-Q2-2026.pdf; headcount-request-worksheet.xlsx
